eyebrow: Terraform & Bicep for Data Engineers · Chapter Four
subtitle: Lesson 19 · IaC in Practice

eyebrow: A resource Terraform has never heard of
code:
# Created by hand, months ago — Terraform
# has never heard of it.
$ az storage account show \
    --name stdataplatformprod \
    --resource-group rg-data-platform \
    --query id -o tsv

/subscriptions/.../storageAccounts/stdataplatformprod
caption: It's real and running — you just need its ID first.

code:
resource "azurerm_storage_account" "data" {
  name                     = "stdataplatformprod"
  resource_group_name      = "rg-data-platform"
  location                 = "eastus2"
  account_tier             = "Standard"
  account_replication_type = "LRS"
}
caption: Import doesn't write this for you — you do.

code:
$ terraform import azurerm_storage_account.data \
    /subscriptions/.../storageAccounts/stdataplatformprod

azurerm_storage_account.data: Importing from ID...
azurerm_storage_account.data: Import prepared!

Import successful!
caption: The resource is now in state — bound, not recreated.
